title: Sara Duterte impeachment trial Day 45: What to expect
summary: The defense team of Vice President Sara Duterte is expected to present its last three witnesses for the week on Friday, November 20.

blocks.text: The defense team of Vice President Sara Duterte is expected to present its last three witnesses for the week on Friday, November 20.

For the 45th day of the impeachment, the defense lawyers will present Department of Trade and Industry Undersecretary for Industry Development and Investment Promotions Group Ceferino Rodolfo and Food and Drug Administration Center for Food Regulation and Research director Pilar Marilyn Pagayunan.

Meanwhile, Department Manager III Rowena Mendoza from the Center for International Expositions and Missions (CITEM) of the Golden Shell Pavilion won't be able to attend due to an official trip abroad. She will be replaced by lawyer Eva Marie Mariquina.
The three witnesses will continue to testify on the status of Cale88 Foods Corporation, a declared asset of the Vice President’s husband, Atty. Manases Carpio.

Moreover, the Senate impeachment court is expected to announce the next schedule of the impeachment trial as the upper chamber will also begin the plenary debates on the 2027 General Appropriations Bill on November 23.

"We will announce tomorrow the scheduled hearings for next month, and or next week, depending on how the decision of the Senate President, the majority with respect to the budget, as we have done so in the past, especially for the month of December," said Senate impeachment court presiding officer Francis "Chiz" Escudero. —LDF, GMA News
